description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping Act, Mo. 52 of 1971 Merchant Shipping Regulations No. 01 of 2021 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of new regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes legal requirements for ship surveys and certificates to implement the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for maritime safety.
